claims.text: For black exhaust smoke, the indicated diagnostic system is the fuel system.
Black exhaust smoke may indicate excessive fuel entering the cylinders.
During air-intake PMCS checks, correct CDR-valve function is determined by checking vacuum with a water manometer.
The authorized cleaning method is wiping the CDR valve and hoses with a rag.
Solvent cleaning of the CDR valve and hoses is prohibited.
Solvent cleaning will damage the diaphragm inside the CDR valve.
